name: acme-demo
source:
# acme-demo · the Deedglass demo policy (S14: the scratch folder; S15: the orders database and
# the everything upstream)
#
# The orders database (crystaldba/postgres-mcp behind deedglass mcp wrap --connector orders
# --connector-type postgres, so S11's SQL classifier reads args.sql): reads run, writes wait for a
# person, destructive SQL never runs. Through the native connector (postgres.*, S17), a status
# update of orders runs and is witnessed at L2 by Postgres's change log (S21's hero). Rule order matters: DROP hits block-destructive-sql first, so
# the message on camera is exactly the brand's example sentence.
#
# The everything upstream (the MCP gateway, /mcp/everything): its harmless demo tools run;
# get-env and the rest fall to the default deny and are hidden.
#
# The fake connector runs freely. The scratch folder (the MCP filesystem server behind
# deedglass mcp wrap --connector scratch) can be read anywhere it serves, and written only inside
# /tmp/deedglass-demo/allowed. Everything else, including moving files and making directories,
# is denied by default, so deedglass mcp wrap hides those tools from the agent.
#
#   deedglass policy test examples/demo/policies/acme-demo.yaml
#
# Paths are compared as text. The filesystem server resolves symlinks itself and refuses paths
# outside the directories it was started with; this policy doesn't see where a symlink points.
deedglass: policy/v1
name: acme-demo
description: Acme Store demo. Reads run, writes wait for a person, destructive SQL never runs.

defaults:
  decision: deny
  reason: No rule allows this action. Add a rule in Console › Policies to allow it.

budgets:
  - id: agent-rate
    per: agent
    window: minute
    max_calls: 30

rules:
  - id: block-destructive-sql
    match: { tool: [orders.execute_sql, postgres.query, postgres.execute] }
    when: sql.kind == "drop"
    decision: deny
    reason: DROP is never allowed for agents.
  - id: block-schema-changes
    match: { tool: [orders.execute_sql, postgres.query, postgres.execute] }
    when: sql.category in ["ddl", "privilege", "server_code", "unknown"] || sql.multi || sql.ambiguous
    decision: deny
    reason: Schema changes, privileges, server code and multi-statement SQL are never allowed for agents.
  - id: block-unscoped-writes
    match: { tool: [orders.execute_sql, postgres.query, postgres.execute] }
    when: sql.unbounded_write
    decision: deny
    reason: UPDATE and DELETE need a WHERE clause.
  - id: no-deletes-on-orders
    match: { tool: [orders.execute_sql, postgres.query, postgres.execute] }
    when: sql.kind == "delete" || "delete" in sql.write_kinds
    decision: deny
    reason: Agents never delete orders. Set the status to 'cancelled' instead.
  - id: undo-needs-approval
    description: An undo (S23) puts rows back the way Postgres recorded them; a person countersigns it first.
    match: { tool: "*.undo", connector_type: postgres }
    decision: require_approval
    reason: Undoing a write changes data again, so a human confirms it first.
    approval: { approvers: [role:admin], required: 1, expires_in: 30m }
    verify: L2
  - id: allow-order-status-updates
    description: Single-order status changes run; Postgres witnesses every one (S21).
    match: { tool: postgres.execute }
    when: >-
      sql.kind == "update" && sql.tables == ["public.orders"] && sql.tables_complete
      && !sql.unbounded_write && !sql.multi && !sql.cte_write && size(sql.unknown_functions) == 0
    decision: allow
    verify: L2
  - id: allow-ship-order
    match: { tool: postgres.call }
    when: has(args.function) && args.function == "public.ship_order"
    decision: allow
  - id: orders-writes-need-approval
    match: { tool: [orders.execute_sql, postgres.execute] }
    when: sql.writes
    decision: require_approval
    reason: Writes to the orders database need a person to countersign.
    approval: { approvers: [role:admin], required: 1, expires_in: 30m }
  - id: allow-order-reads
    match: { tool: [orders.execute_sql, postgres.query] }
    when: sql.category == "read" && !sql.writes
    decision: allow
    verify: L0
  - id: allow-schema-browsing
    match: { tool: [orders.list_schemas, orders.list_objects, orders.get_object_details, postgres.describe] }
    decision: allow
  - id: allow-plain-explain
    match: { tool: orders.explain_query }
    when: sql.category == "read" && !sql.writes && !sql.explain_analyze && !(has(args.analyze) && args.analyze == true)
    decision: allow
  - id: allow-everything-demo-tools
    match: { tool: [everything.echo, everything.get-sum, everything.get-tiny-image, everything.get-annotated-message, everything.get-structured-content] }
    decision: allow
  - id: allow-fake
    match: { tool: ["fake.*"] }
    decision: allow
  - id: allow-scratch-reads
    match: { tool: ["scratch.read_*", "scratch.list_*", scratch.get_file_info, scratch.search_files, scratch.directory_tree] }
    decision: allow
  - id: scratch-writes-only-in-allowed
    match: { tool: [scratch.write_file, scratch.edit_file] }
    when: '!has(args.path) || !args.path.startsWith("/tmp/deedglass-demo/allowed/") || args.path.contains("..")'
    decision: deny
    reason: Agents may only write inside /tmp/deedglass-demo/allowed.
  - id: scratch-writes-in-allowed
    match: { tool: [scratch.write_file, scratch.edit_file] }
    decision: allow
